comments.content: When `v.Metadata` is a nil map, assigning it to the `interface{}` field creates a non-nil interface containing a typed nil, so `omitempty` does not omit it and the response contains `"metadata":null`. This contradicts the documented response shape when metadata is absent (and the new test currently enshrines the incorrect output). Keep `response.Metadata` typed as `map[string]any`, or only assign it when `v.Metadata != nil`, and update the test to expect the field to be absent.
